info.name: CalisHealth - Content Manager Exercise & Workout Management
info.description: End-to-end Postman checks for Content Manager exercise/workout screens. Configure cmEmail/cmPassword. For detail/update/status requests, set systemExerciseCode and workoutCode to existing editable records; pendingExerciseCode must be a CUSTOM exercise awaiting review. Requests are grouped by screen and mutation workflows. Run the exercise create request before the workout create request; the created codes are saved automatically. Cleanup requests delete only the records created by this collection.

exec: pm.test('Authenticated identity is Content Manager', function () { pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('CONTENT_MANAGER'); });
pm.test('Current user is returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Role is Content Manager', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().role).to.eql('CONTENT_MANAGER'); });
pm.test('Exercise list is an array', function () { pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); });

if (item) pm.test('Exercise list rows include management fields', function () { pm.expect(item).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('active'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('source'); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Detail matches requested code and has screen fields', function () { pm.expect(body.code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('systemExerciseCode')); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('muscleGroup'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('guide'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('category'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('active'); }); }

item.name: Delete created exercise (run after workout cleanup)

exec: pm.test('Created exercise is deleted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test('Pending moderation list returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Pending moderation is an array of inactive custom exercises', function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); rows.forEach(x => { pm.expect(x.source).to.eql('CUSTOM'); pm.expect(x.active).to.eql(false); }); });
pm.test('Pending exercise detail returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Detail is custom and pending', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('pendingExerciseCode')); pm.expect(body.source).to.eql('CUSTOM'); pm.expect(body.active).to.eql(false); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Exercise is now active', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().active).to.eql(true); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Exercise is now inactive', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().active).to.eql(false); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('History has expected review fields', function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); if (rows.length) { pm.expect(rows[0]).to.have.property('decision'); pm.expect(rows[0]).to.have.property('reviewedAt'); pm.expect(rows[0].decision).to.be.oneOf(['APPROVED', 'REJECTED']); } });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Workout list rows include management fields', function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); const item = rows.find(x => x.code === pm.collectionVariables.get('workoutCode')); if (item) { pm.expect(item).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('active'); pm.expect(item.exercises).to.be.an('array'); } });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Workout detail has plan and exercise data', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('workoutCode')); pm.expect(body.exercises).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('restSeconds'); });

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Postman CM Workout {{$timestamp}}",
  "description": "Temporary workout created by the Content Manager collection.",
  "restSeconds": 60,
  "level": "Beginner",
  "exerciseCodes": ["{{createdExerciseCode}}"]
}

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdWorkoutCode', body.code); pm.test('Workout has generated code and selected exercise', function () { pm.expect(body.code).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.exercises).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(body.exercises[0].code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('createdExerciseCode')); }); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Updated workout values are persisted', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.name).to.include('Updated'); pm.expect(body.restSeconds).to.eql(90); pm.expect(body.level).to.eql('Intermediate'); });
pm.test('Workout status update succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Workout can be reactivated', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Created workout is deleted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
